text:
Ava (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — putting together the QBR agenda for partner program ops next week. Need to realign co-invest credit runway, reassign partner tier cohorts, and tighten release policy for campaign credits. Can we do a short sync today to land the scoring tweaks and runway assumptions? :eyes:

Diego (Finance): Yep. Can you share the target outcomes? I can bring committed credits, current burn rate, and a 6mo forecast. Reminder: end-of-cycle budget freeze Fri.

Maya (Marketplace): We have two marketplace launches that need dedicated credits (CloudRange + OrbitSI). Rough ask: reserve ~40k credits each for launch promos and joint content. Also need a gating checklist for marketplace listing approvals.

Ethan (SI Ops): For SI integrations, prefer credits to be tied to integration milestones rather than quarter blocks. Proposal: flag allocations with `integration_phase` so we can release on discovery/pilot/GA.

Liam (Partnerships PM): Draft scoring proposal: weight ARR pipeline 50%, joint announcements 30%, enablement / GTM readiness 20%. Quick formula (prototype):
```
score = floor(0.5 * ARR_index + 0.3 * announce_index + 0.2 * enable_index)
```
If score >= threshold assign Tier A/B/C cohort. Thoughts?

Olga (Partner Success): +1 to milestone-tied credits. Also push to include partner NPS / pilot success as part of `enable_index`. Practically: recommend 50% upfront, 50% on milestone completion for integration credits.

Ava (Partnerships): Good notes. Diego — can you run the 6mo runway under the new score weights and the 50/50 release policy? I'll update the cohort assignment tab in the sheet and add a column for `legal_cofund_required`. Sync for 30m today at 3:00pm PT? calendar-bot — please schedule. :calendar:

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled — "Partner Ops: Co-invest runway & cohort sync" (30m) today 3:00 PM PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 | Add to calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd

Diego (Finance): Uploaded a preliminary sheet with assumptions: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE_LINK — I marked committed credits, open asks, and legal locks. Quick Q: which partners are locked to legal co-funding clauses? @Maya?

Maya (Marketplace): CloudRange and OrbitSI both have legal co-funding clauses in their deals (clause ref: GC-4.2). I'll DM the contract snippets and highlight any payout timing constraints.

Ethan (SI Ops): For the `integration_phase` flag let's use an enum: `discovery|pilot|ga`. I'll add that to the scorecard schema and update the onboarding playbook with a sample milestone checklist.

Liam (Partnerships PM): Put a draft scorecard tab in the sheet (same link). Please leave comments on weighting and thresholds by EOD so we can lock before the sync.

Olga (Partner Success): I'll prep partner outreach templates (email + one-pager) that reflect the new release cadence. Will coordinate staggered releases (50% upfront / 50% on milestone) and readiness review.

Ava (Partnerships): If anyone can't make 3pm drop availability here. Agenda will focus on three asks: 1) runway and commit forecast, 2) cohort/tier assignments & scoring, 3) release policy and legal gating.

Diego (Finance): I might be 5-10m late — will upload the updated forecast ASAP.

Maya (Marketplace): :thumbsup:

Ethan (SI Ops): Added a short snippet to the sheet for the milestone checklist and schema examples (columns: partner, integration_phase, milestone, evidence_link).

Liam (Partnerships PM): Final note — if we adopt the 50/30/20 weights we should run a sensitivity test (treat ARR as noisy input). Diego, can you include a +/-20% ARR scenariovar in the runway tab?

Diego (Finance): On it. Will include base / optimistic / conservative.

Ava (Partnerships): Thanks team — talk at 3. I'll post the short agenda and meeting notes after. :white_check_mark:
